heading: ## Repeated controls and gate registry — round 12

findings.skill_statement: Retained control evidence goes to a caller-named /tmp path: the lane's own scratch rule (SKILL.md:25 at C*) puts every seat/round tree under $HYAKU_SCRATCH (default /fast/scratch/hyaku)/<lane>-r<round>-<n>-*/ and allows /tmp for files under 50 MB only, and the section's own last line warns that the retained stdout/stderr may contain sensitive data. `--out` copies every run's full stdout and stderr with no size cap into a directory the tool creates mode 0755, so neither the size bound nor the namespace can be honoured by following this recipe; the same file's other recipes name $HYAKU_SCRATCH (SKILL.md:136, :158, :1982).

The section's sources are S004 and S026. S026 is held-superseded: corpus/SOURCES.md:140 records S265 (added in round 48, corpus/SOURCES.md:500 'superseding held S026') as superseding S026's anchor and quote, and the note cited on this same line opens 'S265 (supersedes S026)'. The lane's convention elsewhere is to name the supersede explicitly (SKILL.md:1565 'S048 supersedes S047's object-specific', SKILL.md:1688 'superseded in round 17'), so the unqualified S026 pointer sends a reader to a superseded row.
